newsitem.title: UK: Gallaher welcomes American Brands spin off.
newsitem.headline: Gallaher welcomes American Brands spin off.

text.p: Gallaher, the Silk Cut and Benson & Hedges cigarette maker, on Tuesday welcomed its spin-off from American Brands Inc, saying the move would create a more focused UK-based tobacco group.

"We welcome the move and look forward with confidence," said Ian Birks, Gallaher general manager of corporate affairs. "It means we will be a 100 percent focused tobacco company and that is a proposal we are very excited about."
Gallaher shares are expected to join the FTSE 100 of leading UK companies when they are separated from American Brands during 1997, assuming the deal is cleared by the U.S. tax authorities.

The stock will be the second pure UK tobacco stock, after the recent Imperial Tobacco Plc demerger from Hanson Plc. Imperial shares rose sharply after the stock joined the FTSE on the demerger last week, to close at 415p today.
Gallaher employs 3,700 in the UK and it has a major share of the UK tobacco market.
